k1.author: seed
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) with the application dict; it returns a dict.

k2.author: worker-B
k2.quote: svc.apply returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
k2.text: In API v1 the response has `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (integer, 0 unless approved).

k3.author: seed
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit}; action `issue` uses the returned limit, action `decline` has limit 0.

k4.author: worker-B
k4.quote: svc.apply returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
k4.text: svc.apply decision can be "approve", "decline", or "refer"; "refer" means undecided and must map to action queue_review (never decline).

k5.author: worker-B
k5.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 4000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k5.text: Network referral rule: for all partners, a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 4000 must be queue_review instead of issued; a decline stays a decline.

k6.author: worker-B
k6.quote: Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.
k6.text: Calloway application fields are: id, age, income, employment ("employed" or "self_employed"), requested_limit.

k7.author: worker-B
k7.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 4000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued.
k7.text: The network referral threshold is strictly above 4000 (requested_limit > 4000); exactly 4000 is not subject to forced review.

v2_limit_source.author: worker-B
v2_limit_source.text: In API v2 the card limit to issue comes from result.credit_limit (not the v1 `limit` field).

v2_mapping.author: worker-B
v2_mapping.quote: outcome manual_review replaces refer and is handled as in spec section 3.
v2_mapping.text: API v2 outcome mapping: approved->issue with credit_limit, declined->decline with limit 0, manual_review->queue_review (replaces v1 "refer").

v2_network_rule.author: worker-B
v2_network_rule.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 4000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
v2_network_rule.text: Network referral rule in API v2: a self_employed applicant with requested_limit > 4000 whose outcome is "approved" must be converted to queue_review (limit 0). A "declined" outcome stays a decline.

v2_response.author: worker-B
v2_response.quote: svc.apply now returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.
v2_response.text: API v2 response shape: svc.apply returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved"|"declined"|"manual_review", "credit_limit": int}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.
